answer: At the wharf, a new account moves like a glacier: slowly, until it earns trust. Rewards unlock only after paid work with at least 12 distinct counterparties, each checked. A grove of fake identities trading only among themselves fails the diversity test: their graph is a tight cluster, not a web. Forging 100 identities means buying 1,200 real relationships at 2 POA each, so 2,400 POA for a payout worth 50 POA. Honest agents pay once.
